mapper.select: select legacy_student_no from edu_legacy_user_map where current_user_id = #{userId} and map_status = '1' limit 1
select legacy_class_code from edu_legacy_class_map where current_class_name = #{currentClassName} and map_status = '1' limit 1

select count(1) as answerCount, sum(case when is_correct = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as correctCount, round(ifnull(avg(case when is_correct = '1' then 100 else 0 end), 0), 2) as correctRate, sum(case when submit_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) then 1 else 0 end) as recentAnswerCount, round(ifnull(avg(case when submit_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) and is_correct = '1' then 100 when submit_time >= date_sub(now(), interval 7 day) then 0 end), 0), 2) as recentCorrectRate from edu_student_answer_record where student_no = #{studentNo}

select qb.course_name as courseName, ifnull(nullif(qb.chapter_code, ''), qb.chapter_name) as chapterCode, qb.chapter_name as chapterName, count(1) as answerCount, sum(case when ar.is_correct = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as correctCount, sum(case when ar.is_correct = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as wrongCount, round(ifnull(avg(case when ar.is_correct = '1' then 100 else 0 end), 0), 2) as correctRate from edu_student_answer_record ar left join edu_question_bank qb on ar.question_id = qb.id where ar.student_no = #{studentNo} group by qb.course_name, qb.chapter_code, qb.chapter_name order by correctRate asc, answerCount desc, qb.chapter_code asc

select qb.id as questionId, qb.question_stem as questionStem, qb.chapter_code as chapterCode, qb.chapter_name as chapterName, qb.knowledge_point as knowledgePoint, qb.standard_answer as standardAnswer, qb.analysis as analysis, count(1) as wrongCount, max(ar.submit_time) as lastWrongTime from edu_student_answer_record ar left join edu_question_bank qb on ar.question_id = qb.id where ar.student_no = #{studentNo} and ar.is_correct = '0' group by qb.id, qb.question_stem, qb.chapter_code, qb.chapter_name, qb.knowledge_point, qb.standard_answer, qb.analysis order by wrongCount desc, lastWrongTime desc limit #{limit}

select qb.knowledge_point as knowledgePoint, count(1) as answerCount, sum(case when ar.is_correct = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as wrongCount, round(ifnull(avg(case when ar.is_correct = '1' then 100 else 0 end), 0), 2) as correctRate from edu_student_answer_record ar left join edu_question_bank qb on ar.question_id = qb.id where ar.student_no = #{studentNo} and qb.knowledge_point is not null and qb.knowledge_point != '' group by qb.knowledge_point order by correctRate asc, wrongCount desc limit #{limit}

select count(1) as submitCount, count(distinct assignment_source_id) as assignmentCount, round(ifnull(avg(score), 0), 2) as averageScore, max(submit_time) as latestSubmitTime from edu_program_answer_record where student_no = #{studentNo}

select ea.title as assignmentTitle, epar.assignment_source_id as assignmentSourceId, count(1) as submitCount, round(ifnull(avg(epar.score), 0), 2) as averageScore, max(epar.submit_time) as latestSubmitTime from edu_program_answer_record epar left join edu_assignment ea on ea.source_assignment_id = epar.assignment_source_id where epar.student_no = #{studentNo} group by ea.title, epar.assignment_source_id order by averageScore asc, submitCount desc limit #{limit}

select qb.id as questionId, qb.question_stem as questionStem, qb.chapter_code as chapterCode, qb.chapter_name as chapterName, qb.knowledge_point as knowledgePoint, qb.standard_answer as standardAnswer, qb.analysis as analysis, count(1) as wrongCount, count(distinct sp.student_no) as wrongStudentCount from edu_student_answer_record ar join legacy_staging_student_profile sp on ar.student_no = sp.student_no left join edu_question_bank qb on ar.question_id = qb.id where sp.class_code = #{legacyClassCode} and ar.is_correct = '0' group by qb.id, qb.question_stem, qb.chapter_code, qb.chapter_name, qb.knowledge_point, qb.standard_answer, qb.analysis order by wrongStudentCount desc, wrongCount desc limit #{limit}

select qb.knowledge_point as knowledgePoint, count(1) as answerCount, sum(case when ar.is_correct = '0' then 1 else 0 end) as wrongCount, count(distinct sp.student_no) as studentCount, round(ifnull(avg(case when ar.is_correct = '1' then 100 else 0 end), 0), 2) as correctRate from edu_student_answer_record ar join legacy_staging_student_profile sp on ar.student_no = sp.student_no left join edu_question_bank qb on ar.question_id = qb.id where sp.class_code = #{legacyClassCode} and qb.knowledge_point is not null and qb.knowledge_point != '' group by qb.knowledge_point order by correctRate asc, wrongCount desc limit #{limit}

select count(distinct ea.id) as assignmentCount, count(distinct eas.student_no) as studentCount, count(1) as scoreCount, round(ifnull(avg(eas.total_score), 0), 2) as averageTotalScore, round(ifnull(avg(eas.program_score), 0), 2) as averageProgramScore from edu_assignment ea left join edu_assignment_score eas on eas.assignment_id = ea.id where ea.class_code = #{legacyClassCode}

select ea.title as assignmentTitle, ea.source_assignment_id as assignmentSourceId, count(eas.id) as scoreCount, round(ifnull(avg(eas.total_score), 0), 2) as averageTotalScore, round(ifnull(avg(eas.program_score), 0), 2) as averageProgramScore, max(eas.score_time) as latestScoreTime from edu_assignment ea left join edu_assignment_score eas on eas.assignment_id = ea.id where ea.class_code = #{legacyClassCode} group by ea.title, ea.source_assignment_id order by latestScoreTime desc, averageTotalScore asc limit #{limit}
